name: researcher-social
description: > A visual micro-publishing platform designed specifically for researchers, academics, and science enthusiasts. Turn dense, 20-page papers into elegant, bite-sized horizontal carousels with deep-dive technical slides.

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js cache-manager.js card-generator.js html2canvas.min.js styles.css papers-data.json primer-data.json books-data.json supabase-client.js www/
scripts.sync: npm run copy-assets && npx cap sync android
